preview: Work we prepare | What it helps you do

text: Source: revised draft support proposal dated October 30, 2026, output/pdf/WaistLess-Foods-Support-Proposal-Draft.pdf. This is an illustrative plan pending a team estimate and final scope, not committed monthly quantities. One newsletter draft uses the existing template, up to 600 words of supplied final copy, one call-to-action link, and one consolidated revision round. Each of four static graphics has one agreed message and size, based on approved templates, with one consolidated revision round. Each of two content updates covers one existing page or recipe entry using final supplied text and one supplied image. Website checks and minor fixes must fit the agreed technical scope. The monthly review is up to 30 minutes. Ask which work Amber actually wants to hand over.

name: text-69
text: Success means useful work completed and less routine work left with Amber

This trial is optional and starts only after we agree on the current project closeout, scope, budget, and staffing in writing. Ask what support Amber wants before proposing a package. Record a baseline for recurring tasks in month one. Use completed tasks, time required, revision effort, and Amber’s feedback to judge usefulness. Do not promise sales growth or a fixed number of hours saved. At the end of month three, review whether to continue, resize, or end under the agreed terms.

Ask Amber to identify the two tasks she would most like help with. Close the normal presentation here. Ask permission conversationally to prepare a tailored written proposal after learning her workload and budget. Only show the hidden appendix manually if she asks about pricing. HIDDEN APPENDIX. Normal slideshow playback skips this slide. Show it manually only if Amber asks about budget after discussing her recurring tasks. Source: revised draft support proposal dated October 30, 2026. Website support is provisionally USD $300 per month with up to five combined service hours for technical work and coordination. Monthly Website & Content Support is provisionally USD $700 per month with fifteen combined staff hours: five technical, eight design/admin, and two coordination/review. These are planning limits in the detailed terms, not extra production time above the sample deliverables. Meetings, revisions, testing, and reporting count. The content plan on slide 4 is illustrative and must be estimated before quantities are promised. Confirm staffing, full delivery cost, and final scope before issuing a quote. One newsletter draft, four graphics, two updates, a website check with small fixes, and a monthly review are the proposed example, not a committed output package.
